source_metadata.etymology_text: Inherited from Old Galician-Portuguese sentir, from Latin sentīre, from Proto-Indo-European *sent- (“to head for, go”).
raw_glosses: (subordinating) to feel; to think (to vaguely expect that something is the case or will happen)

unused_menu_senses.translation: to feel; to think (to vaguely expect that something is the case or will happen)

canonical_example.text: Posso ajudá-lo de alguma forma?
